description: This file defines a template class 'PingPongEnabled' that provides WebSocket ping-pong functionality, including starting pings, handling pong responses, and connection state management.

classes.name: PingPongEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing WebSocket ping-pong heartbeat functionality, including starting pings, handling pong responses, and connection state logging.

methods.name: startPing
methods.description: Initializes ping-pong mechanism by setting pong handlers and scheduling periodic pings.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Sets a timer to invoke a callback after a specified interval.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message over the WebSocket connection if the connection is open.

methods.name: onPong
methods.description: Handles receipt of a pong message and schedules the next ping.

methods.name: onPongTimeout
methods.description: Handles pong timeout by closing the connection.

methods.name: printConnectionState
methods.description: Logs the current state of the WebSocket connection.
